verdict.rationale: Foreloop is a SaaS platform with a CLI, MCP access and a feedback widget, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only CLI commands, JSON output and widget installation, with no interactive API reference or runnable examples. CLI documentation is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
